WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption_2013) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        CAST(SUM(cc.total_consumption_2013) AS REAL) / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment mp 
        ON cc.Segment = mp.Segment 
        AND cc.total_consumption_2013 = mp.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
